prompt: Per $100M Offers, what types of guarantees does Hormozi describe, how should I word one, and will a strong guarantee lose me money from refunds? I run a high-cost done-for-you marketing service.
assertions: Lists four guarantee types: unconditional, conditional, anti-guarantee, implied/performance
Gives the 'If you do not get X result in Y time, we will Z' structure with a weak vs strong example
Works the refund math (e.g., 100 sales/5% refunds = 95 vs 130 sales/10% refunds = 117, about 23% more)
Notes that high-cost services should favor conditional or anti-guarantees
Recommends tying conditions to key actions the client must take and/or 'better than money back' guarantees
Mentions stacking guarantees or warns that guarantee-only buyers can be poor customers
